name: prisma
description: Connect Codex to a scoped Prisma instance.

interface.shortDescription: Use scoped Prisma tools from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex terminal sessions to Prisma through user-controlled scoped API tokens. Codex must use /api/codex/* endpoints so Prisma Settings can enforce tool access.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Prisma only through configured scoped access. Check capabilities before reading or writing data.
